name: Legendary Foods Protein Donuts — Chocolate Dipped

source.author: Legendary Foods
source.notes: Requested via iHerb (il.iherb.com), egress-blocked by the proxy. Values from Legendary Foods' published label via web (manufacturer/retailer). Clearly reported: 160 kcal, 20g protein, 6g fat (1g sat), 23g total carb, 6g fiber, 12g erythritol, 5g net carb, 0g sugar. Sodium ~220mg estimated. Verify vs the physical IL wrapper if it differs.

ingredients.item: protein blend (milk protein isolate, dried egg whites, whey protein isolate, sodium caseinate)
high-oleic sunflower oil, unsweetened chocolate / cocoa (chocolate dip)
modified resistant tapioca starch, natural flavors

steps: Packaged protein donut (vanilla cake, half-dipped in chocolate) — eat as-is.

him.verdict: Nearly identical to the cinnamon version and just as good on the headline macros: 20 g protein for 160 kcal, 0 g sugar, ~5 g net carb — a chocolate-dessert craving that fits a cut. One notch lower than the cinnamon only because it has less fiber (6 g vs 8 g) and MORE sugar alcohol (12 g erythritol vs 8 g), so it's the more likely of the two to cause bloating/GI if you eat more than one.
suggested_mods: Great chocolate-craving swap; keep to 1 pack (12 g erythritol is a lot to double up on)
If choosing between the two Legendary donuts, the cinnamon crumble edges it (more fiber, less sugar alcohol)

her_preconception.verdict: Same good protein (20 g) and low sugar as the cinnamon, but the 12 g erythritol is a notable sugar-alcohol load — more likely to have a laxative/GI effect, which is worth being mindful of in pregnancy. No prenatal micros. Contains milk and egg.

safety_advisories.note: High sugar-alcohol load (12 g erythritol) — can have a laxative/GI effect; sweeteners considered pregnancy-safe in moderation but this one is worth limiting.
safety_advisories.swap: the cinnamon crumble version (less erythritol), or a whole-food snack

suggested_mods: Occasional only; the cinnamon version is the gentler pick for her

adopted_note: Adopted into the rotation 2026-08-09 as a regular sweet/protein snack. Label values, reuse directly: 1 pack (2 donuts, 61 g) = 160 kcal, 20 g protein, 6 g fiber, ~5 g net carb, 0 g sugar. Standing guidance: keep to ~1 pack — 12 g erythritol is a notable sugar-alcohol load (GI/bloat if stacked); the cinnamon version is the gentler of the two.
